message.content: The case concerns whether to close the review for filter train M2. Claim A that M2 passed the April pressure test is unresolved, supported only by hearsay from maintenance chat without direct test data. Claim B, that a bypass on M2 triggered a flow alarm at 09:10, is well supported by control historian records with high confidence. Claim C, that M2 was serviced that morning, is contradicted by shift sign-off documentation stating no service occurred, also with high confidence. Given the unresolved test status and the flow alarm indicating a potential issue, alongside no confirmed servicing, it would be prudent not to close the review for M2 until further verification or test results are obtained.
